purpose: Receive the optional SVG pieces construction through the existing project/export path and compare one incompatible authored pair against its preserved original single-cutout result.

course.fitCountSemantics: Selected fixed helper control flow and mode-specific successful receipts; not independent dynamic tracing.

refusals.expected: Pieces construction requires an integer --max-pieces from 1 through 24.
Pieces construction requires lightShare=0 because the maintained engine uses a fixed light.

baseline.use: Read, hash and copy the original saved project; never refit it.

admission.sourceIdentity: Every staged file must match the Git source-freeze manifest before launch.
admission.capacityLimit: Host MemAvailable and process affinity are observations of this route, not cgroup capacity guarantees.

comparison.method: Independent point-light projection at authored keys; cell-center point-in-polygon classification with half-open y and strict x crossing; Boolean union over projected pieces.
comparison.score: XOR cell count divided by union cell count between predicted and target masks.
comparison.containment: Every target and predicted polygon vertex must be inside the observation window; no outside-window clipping credit.
comparison.thresholdMeaning: Prechosen practical two-percentage-point improvement and per-key guard, not a floating-point tolerance or promised outcome.
comparison.configurationLimit: Original single construction used lightShare .65; the new pieces construction uses fixed light with share zero. This compares whole constructions, not the isolated causal effect of piece count.
comparison.artifacts: Retain raw 0/1 byte masks, projected polygon coordinates, occupancy, XOR and union counts for target, original single and new pieces at both authored keys.

criteria.decodedForeground: Pillow luminance <128, nonempty and no classified foreground on image edges for all 96 frames.
criteria.contactSheets: Four ordered 24-frame sheets from the same complete decode; no additional encode or decode.

evidence.ordering: Produce and decode the pieces movie before applying practical-benefit gates, so an adverse comparison retains downstream evidence.
retained: Original launch request and initial/final tool responses
Admission, child PID and terminal supervisor state
Raw comparison masks and projected coordinates
All-frame geometry, timing, decoded hashes and foreground bounds
Four selected decoded PNGs and four complete contact sheets
Separate static, data and visual reviews with their actual scope
evidence.visualReview: Review retained contact sheets and selected frames separately; do not edit the original receiver result to replace its pending-review marker.

integration.afterReceiving: Preserve the original observations; document actual results and limitations, add the necessary package entries and public receiving summary, then build and verify the final package once. Do not replay the product course for packaging.
integration.browserReceiving: Separate held PR11 browser gate is unchanged.
integration.unresolvedReadout: Original readout custody is separate; no replay.

limits: Fixed-grid estimates do not establish continuous geometry equivalence or arbitrary SVG fidelity.
The piece cap does not bound all solver work; the maintained fitter also measures its report.
Finite geometry and luminance observations do not establish continuous framing, perceptual smoothness or fabrication safety.
Lossless YUV encoding does not imply exact RGB or browser pixel identity.
The chosen fixture and practical threshold do not establish a universal improvement or performance claim.
